_readme: Cross-language fixed vectors for the Noise fresh-DH rekey, read by backend/internal/noise/noise_test.go and frontend/src/lib/noise.test.ts. The rekey mixes a fresh X25519 DH secret into the current key: ck1 = HKDF(k, dhSecret); k' = HKDF(ck1, nil)[0:32]. One warmup encryption advances the nonce (rekey resets it), then the plaintext is encrypted under the derived key and must produce expectedCiphertextHex on BOTH sides -- a derivation that drifts reddens both suites on the same bytes.
